You reached Level ${appState.level}`); updateStudyStreak(); saveState(); updateUIStats(); } function updateStudyStreak(){ const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10); if(appState.lastStudyDate === today) return; const yesterday = new Date(Date.now()-86400000).toISOString().slice(0,10); if(appState.lastStudyDate === yesterday) appState.streak = Math.max(1, appState.streak+1); else if(appState.lastStudyDate) appState.streak = 1; appState.lastStudyDate = today; } function setupAiKey(){ const current=localStorage.getItem("studyquest_gemini_key")||""; const key=prompt("Paste your Gemini API key for the AI Tutor prototype:",current); if(key!==null){ localStorage.setItem("studyquest_gemini_key",key.trim()); showToast(key.trim() ? "🤖 AI key saved locally." : "AI key cleared."); } } function showToast(message){ const el=document.createElement("div"); el.className="toast"; el.textContent=message; document.body.appendChild(el); setTimeout(()=>el.remove(),2600); } function closeModal(id){document.getElementById(id)?.classList.add("hidden");} function openProfileModal(){ document.getElementById("profileXp").textContent=appState.xp; document.getElementById("profileLevel").textContent=appState.level; document.getElementById("profileStreak").textContent=appState.streak; document.getElementById("profileModal").classList.remove("hidden"); } function openAdminModal(){ document.getElementById("adminSubjects").textContent=Object.keys(COURSE_DATA).length; document.getElementById("adminTopics").textContent=Object.values(COURSE_DATA).reduce((n,s)=>n+s.topics.length,0); document.getElementById("adminQuestions").textContent=Object.values(COURSE_DATA).reduce((n,s)=>n+s.topics.reduce((m,t)=>m+t.qs.length,0),0); document.getElementById("adminModal").classList.remove("hidden"); } function openPremiumModal(){document.getElementById("premiumModal").classList.remove("hidden");} function openAiGenerator(){document.getElementById("aiGeneratorModal").classList.remove("hidden");} function openMasteryMatrixModal(){ const box=document.getElementById("masteryMatrixContent"); box.innerHTML=""; Object.entries(COURSE_DATA).forEach(([subject,s])=>{ const row=document.createElement("div"); row.style.marginBottom="16px"; row.innerHTML=`
${s.icon} ${subject}
`; s.topics.forEach(t=>{ const status=appState.topicStatuses[t.id]||"not-started"; const wrap=document.createElement("div"); wrap.style.margin="6px 0"; wrap.innerHTML=`
${t.icon} ${t.name}${status}
`; row.appendChild(wrap); }); box.appendChild(row); }); document.getElementById("masteryMatrixModal").classList.remove("hidden"); } function openQuestsModal(){ const box=document.getElementById("modalQuestsList"); const todayAnswered=appState.answered; const quests=[ [`🎯 Answer 10 questions`, Math.min(todayAnswered,10),10,50], [`⭐ Earn 100 XP`, Math.min(appState.xp%100,100),100,75], [`📚 Master a topic`, Object.values(appState.topicStatuses).filter(v=>v==="mastered").length,1,100] ]; box.innerHTML=quests.map(([name,cur,max,xp])=>`
${name}
${cur}/${max}+${xp} XP
`).join(""); document.getElementById("questsModal").classList.remove("hidden"); } async function askDashboardAI(){ const input=document.getElementById("dashboardAiInput"); const output=document.getElementById("dashboardAiOutput"); const q=input.value.trim(); if(!q)return; output.textContent="Thinking..."; const key=localStorage.getItem("studyquest_gemini_key") || ""; if(!key){ output.textContent="AI key not configured. Try a topic from the curriculum and StudyQuest will open a practice module."; return; } try{ const res=await fetch(`https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini-2.5-flash:generateContent?key=${encodeURIComponent(key)}`,{ method:"POST",headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"}, body:JSON.stringify({contents:[{parts:[{text:`You are StudyQuest's friendly GCSE tutor. Explain clearly and briefly: ${q}`}]}]}) }); const data=await res.json(); if(!res.ok) throw new Error("AI request failed"); output.textContent=data?.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts?.[0]?.text || "No response."; }catch(e){output.textContent="AI is unavailable right now. Check your API setup.";} } function generateQuiz(){ const request=document.getElementById("aiGeneratorInput").value.trim(); const output=document.getElementById("aiGeneratorOutput"); const allTopics=Object.entries(COURSE_DATA).flatMap(([s,o])=>o.topics.map(t=>({subject:s,topic:t}))); const match=allTopics.find(x=>`${x.subject} ${x.topic.name}`.toLowerCase().includes(request.toLowerCase().replace(/10|hard|easy|questions?/g,"").trim())); const chosen=match || allTopics[Math.floor(Math.random()*allTopics.length)]; const qs=[...chosen.topic.qs].sort(()=>Math.random()-.5).slice(0,10); appState.currentSession={subject:chosen.subject,topic:{...chosen.topic,name:`AI Quiz — ${chosen.topic.name}`,qs},qIndex:0,score:0}; closeModal("aiGeneratorModal"); hideAllViews(); document.getElementById("quizView").classList.remove("hidden"); renderQuizStage(); showToast(`🤖 Generated 10-question quiz: ${chosen.topic.name}`); } >
